items: 4 cups baking mix (Jiffy or Bisquick), plus about 1/2 cup for the counter
1 cup 7-Up soda (any clear carbonated drink will work)
Cut the sour cream into your biscuit mix.
Stir in 1/2 cup 7-Up. The dough will be very soft, don't worry.
Sprinkle additional baking mix on to your counter, about a 1/2 cup seems to work just fine.
Knead and fold dough until coated with your baking mix.
Pat dough out (no rolling pin needed) and cut biscuits using a round biscuit/cookie cutter.
Melt butter in a 9x13-inch pan. I stick my pan and butter in the oven for a few minutes. Just a few though, the butter will burn, so watch it.
Place cut biscuits on top of melted butter and bake for 12-15 minutes or until brown.
Don't have a biscuit cutter? No problem, you can certainly use a glass or empty soup can to cut out your biscuits. Improvising is fine.
